title: The Culture Within: Towards Mechanistic Understanding of Cultural Reasoning in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.27202v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate across culturally diverse settings, yet existing evaluations largely measure cultural behavior at the output level. We introduce CultureLens, a reference-grounded benchmark and mechanistic study of how LLMs use cultural information. CultureLens contains 9,261 scenarios across 75 countries and systematically varies country, value, true-norm, and contradictory-norm evidence. Across Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-3-12B, and Qwen-3.5-27B, stating a contradictory norm lowers aligned answers by 32-47 percentage points, even when the model answers correctly from the country alone. Mechanistically, models default to Anglophone norms when no country is given. The failure under a contradictory norm is not one of missing knowledge, as blocking the norm inside the model restores the correct answer in most cases. translated_title: 内在的文化：迈向对大语言模型文化推理的机制性理解
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地在文化多样的环境中运行，但现有的评估大多只是在输出层面衡量文化行为。我们提出了 CultureLens，这是一个基于参考标准的基准测试，同时也是对 LLM 如何使用文化信息的机制性研究。CultureLens 包含覆盖 75 个国家的 9,261 个场景，并系统地变化国家、价值观、真实规范与矛盾规范等证据。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-3-12B 和 Qwen-3.5-27B 上的实验表明，陈述一个矛盾的规范会使与文化一致的回答下降 32-47 个百分点，即使模型仅凭国家信息本可以正确作答。从机制上看，当未给出国家信息时，模型会默认采用英语国家的规范。在矛盾规范下的失败并非源于知识缺失，因为在模型内部阻断该规范后，大多数情况下可以恢复正确的回答。模型是否接受某个被陈述的规范取决于其呈现方式，而非其是否真实。
tldr: 该论文提出覆盖 75 个国家 9,261 个场景的 CultureLens 基准，通过机制性分析发现 LLM 在文化推理中默认采用英语国家规范、接受陈述性规范只看呈现方式而无论真假，且在模型内部阻断矛盾规范即可恢复正确回答，说明其失败源于内部信息处理而非知识缺失。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CultureLens, a 9,261-scenario benchmark across 75 countries, and mechanistically shows that LLMs default to Anglophone norms, accept stated norms based on presentation rather than truth, and that failures under contradictory norms stem from internal processing rather than missing knowledge, since blocking the norm inside the model restores correct answers.
